title: Nonlinear complete-profile storage under MODFLOW STO replacement
activation_rule: Execute only after GC-HLINK01 live gate passes without changing its preregistered storage-replacement semantics.

cases.name: SECANT_STO_ITERATION
cases.representation: At coupling iterate x_k, overwrite MODFLOW Sy with S_sec(x_k)=V(x_k)/x_k; use S0 at x_k=0; keep the physical external input fixed at 0.010 m3.
cases.expected: converges to H=8.056155281280883 and physical mass closes without any numerical source term

cases.name: TANGENT_STO_WITH_AFFINE_CORRECTION
cases.representation: Overwrite MODFLOW Sy with S_tan(x_k)=S0+k*x_k and add only the Newton linearization correction Q_corr=[-V(x_k)+S_tan*x_k]/dt as a numerical API intercept.
cases.fixed_point_identity: S_tan*x = I + Q_corr*dt is the tangent linearization of V(x)=I
cases.expected: converges to the exact physical root; Q_corr is excluded from the physical external-water ledger

cases.name: TANGENT_STO_WITHOUT_CORRECTION
cases.representation: Overwrite MODFLOW Sy with S_tan(x_k) but retain only the physical input I.

gates: Independent analytic V(H) oracle remains exactly the preregistered DSW09 curve.
Secant STO iteration converges to 8.056155281280883 m within 1e-10 m and V(H)-I closes within 1e-12 m3.
Tangent STO plus affine correction converges to the same physical root and physical V(H)-I closes within 1e-12 m3.
The tangent affine correction is reported separately and is not counted as physical external input.
Tangent STO without correction converges to the independently predicted wrong head 8.05 m within 1e-10 m.
The adversarial tangent-only case violates the exact nonlinear physical storage law by more than 1e-4 m3 despite subsystem convergence.
interpretation_rules: A nonlinear h-link cannot in general be represented by inserting a local derivative into MODFLOW Sy and calling that derivative the complete storage law.
A secant response can represent an integrated one-window storage balance, while a tangent requires a consistent affine correction to represent the same nonlinear residual.
Numerical affine corrections are not additional physical water sources.
The correct representation must be derived from the chosen time-discrete physical residual before mapping to MODFLOW STO/API arrays.
forbidden: do not execute before HLINK01 passes
do not infer that real SWAP storage is quadratic
do not treat the Newton affine correction as physical recharge
do not select secant versus tangent for production from this toy case alone
